# Wikibooks procedure discovery captures

Retrieved on 2026-11-21 from the English Wikibooks MediaWiki Action API. The
test support module declares the exact URL for each file. The parse responses
include the Ingredients, Procedure, and variations around the numbered steps,
so the replay checks which section actually supplied the answer.

- [Basic Bread Dough article and attribution](https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Basic_Bread_Dough)
- [North American Pancakes article and attribution](https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Pancakes_(North_American))
- [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
